_readme: Questions Jev asks about every video. {v} is replaced with videos[i] so each question points at one video. Keep the hook option keys as they are: the dashboard colors depend on them. Add your own questions below. per_video_spoken gives the same questions new instructions for Shorts that have a transcript ({v}.opening is the first ~45 seconds of what is said, {v}.transcript all of it); the criteria stay the same.

hook.instructions: Which hook type does the title in `{v}.title` use?

criteria.recognition: Makes a specific type of viewer feel seen
criteria.result: Promises or shows a concrete outcome or number
criteria.contrarian: Challenges common advice or a popular belief
criteria.story: Opens a personal story or moment

structure.instructions: What structure does the video in `{v}` follow, based on its title and description?

criteria.story: Tells a personal story or moment
criteria.listicle: A list of tips, steps, or examples
criteria.problem_solution: Names a problem, then gives the fix
criteria.tutorial: Shows how to do something step by step

cta.instructions: Does `{v}.description` ask the viewer to take an action, like follow, comment, or click a link?

strength.instructions: How strong is `{v}.title` as a hook for a short-form video?

per_video_spoken.hook: Which hook type does the speaker use in `{v}.opening`, the first ~45 seconds of what is said in the video? Use `{v}.title` only if the opening is unclear.
per_video_spoken.structure: What structure does the video follow, based on what is said in `{v}.transcript`?
per_video_spoken.cta: Does the speaker in `{v}.transcript`, or the description in `{v}.description`, ask the viewer to take an action, like follow, comment, or click a link?
per_video_spoken.strength: How strong is the spoken opening `{v}.opening` as a hook for a short-form video?
